user_saw: A new chat could wait about ten seconds before the first model request if a previously discovered MCP server stopped answering tool-list requests.
summary: The fix retains successful MCP catalogs across chats and refreshes them in the background while keeping the bounded wait for first-time discovery.
reasoning: The oldest locally readable code already awaited catalog discovery during tool preparation, and the diff for #157855 raised the default listing timeout from 1.5 to 10 seconds, increasing an existing delay. The older path history stopped at a missing commit, so I could not verify when repeat discovery began or establish that new chats had previously reused known catalogs without waiting.
